system.description:
Beginning at 3rd level you lean maneuvers that are fueled by a special dice called Superiority Dice

Maneuvers: You learn four maneuver of your choice, which are detailed in the Trickster Maneuvers Section at the end of this class. You earn more at higher levels as shown in the “Maneuvers Known” Column of the Superior Trickster table. Many Maneuvers enhance an attack in some way. You can use one maneuver as part of an attack or jutsu casting, once each.

Void Heart

Medium Construct, unaligned

Armor Class 8 + Dex + Con + Prof

Hit Points (Shares Yours)

Speed Equal to yours

STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA

+0 +0 +0 +0 +0 +0

Condition Immunities. Charmed

Senses Darkvision 30 ft., passive Perception 10

Inexhaustible. The Void Soul cannot cast jutsu or use effects that would increase its own ranks of exhaustion.

Attacks

Unarmed Strike. Melee Weapon Attack: Str + Prof to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 1d6 + Str bludgeoning damage.
